info.title: Zscaler Private Access API Portal
info.description: To access detailed ZPA API documentation, including references and use cases, refer to the [Zscaler Help Portal](/zpa/about-zpa-api).

get.summary: Gets all configured user portal links for the specified customer.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description: The ZPA tenant ID of the customer.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Specifies the page number.

parameters.name: pagesize
parameters.description: Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The maximum page size is 500.

parameters.name: microtenantId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the Microtenant for the ZPA tenant. If you are within a Microtenant, you must pass the microtenantId field when making an API call to retrieve data from that Microtenant. The microtenantId can be obtained from the API keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations is limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant.

protocol.description: The protocol for the user portal link. This is only supported for private applications where Browser Access is not enabled. For private applications where Browser Access is enabled, this field defaults to the protocol that was configured in the application segment, and cannot be changed. The supported values are https:// and http://.

enabled.description: Indicates if the user portal is enabled (true) or not (false).

description.description: The description of the user portal.

certificateId.description: The unique identifier of the certificate.

getcName.description: This field is extracted from the enrollment certificate, and is not applicable for PUT and POST requests.

domain.description: The full URL for the user portal. This is the URL that users access to view the portal. The URL must use the HTTPS protocol and be a fully qualified domain name (FQDN). A user portal's FQDN cannot be configured as an application within an application segment. The domain field is only required if managedByZs is set to false.

userNotification.description: The user notification of the user portal.

userNotificationEnabled.description: Indicates if the user notification is enabled (true) or disabled (false) for the user portal.

extDomainTranslation.description: The domain name translation for the user portal.

extLabel.description: The authentication domain name prefix used for the portal URL. The supported string can include integers, lowercase characters, and hyphens (-). This field supports integers between 3 and 31. For example, server-2.

extDomain.description: The authentication domain name prefix used for Zscaler-managed certificates when creating a privileged portal. If you are using Zscaler-managed certificates and pass the external domain name prefix, the certificateId field becomes null. Periods (.) are not supported since the FQDN includes a period as part of the suffix or top-level domain.

extDomainName.description: The authentication domain name for the user portal.
